candidate_decision.predeclared_rule: No paired original-request loss or material false conclusion. At least 10% fewer tokens per accepted task or 10% lower total latency p50, with no worse observed total latency p95. Calibration only, no population qualification.
candidate_decision.reason: Token savings are below 10%; total latency p50 worsens and no latency target is met. Callees and reference-removal token/time costs worsen.
